dedupe_keys.name: mosdac meteorological and oceanographic satellite data archival centre isro

description: MOSDAC, the Meteorological and Oceanographic Satellite Data Archival Centre of the ISRO Space Applications Centre, archives and serves data from Indian meteorological and oceanographic satellites such as INSAT-3DS, together with derived forecast services. Services listed on the home page include 3-hourly city weather forecasts, satellite-based cyclone observation and real-time prediction over the Indian Ocean, heat wave prediction over India with the WRF model, heavy rain forecasts from a numerical weather prediction model, lightning forecasts, monsoon prediction, sea state forecasts of wave height and period, and three-day solar and wind forecasts every 15 minutes. The site has a satellite data catalogue and a user login for data access, and it publishes event images and a newsletter. Access to the services is free online; the data policy is not stated on the page read. Caveats: the home page notes that some information services are not being updated at present, and much content loads by script. Coverage is India and the Indian Ocean. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response for infrastructure during cyclones, heat waves, heavy rain and lightning, and resource forecasts for solar and wind power; related records are JAXA G-Portal and ESA Earth Online.
